certifications_partner.text: The Contractor shall prepare and implement inspection and test plans (ITPs) covering fabrication, dimensional inspections, weld inspections, leak checking (where applicable), and final acceptance testing of both the RF mockup and the prototype. • The RF mockup shall be inspected for dimensional compliance prior to VNA measurements, and the S -parameter test results shall be documented and compared with the approved electromagnetic model. • The prototype shall undergo documented dimensional inspections of all critical features, verification of cooling passage integrity, and UHV cleaning and quality checks prior to delivery. To meet these ESR bunch injection schemes and requirements, an array of stripline-based kickers, individually fed by high voltage (HV) pulse signals of up to +/-30 kV, will be installed in the ESR. The required deflection angle is in the range 1- 1.5 mrad, for the individual stripline kicker we target a deflection angle of ~125 µrad @ 18 GeV, assuming +/-27 kV pulse supply voltage between the kicker electrodes. To keep the losses of the stored beam low, a ~15 σ distance between the stored beam and the injection septa in the ESR must be maintained, which translates into a minimum physical aperture of 30 mm diameter for the stripline kickers.
